title: VW Passat B3 Button Blank / Blank Replacement
author: cosmonut
description:
A 3D printable replacement blank button / switch cover for the **Volkswagen Passat B3**.

I created this part as a replacement for a missing or damaged button/blank in the dashboard.

The model is designed to fit in the original mounting location and can be printed as a replacement part.

**Features:**

• Designed for VW Passat B3

• Replacement button / switch blank

• FDM printable

• No supports required _(если действительно печатается без поддержек)_

• Simple and lightweight design

I printed and tested the part myself.

**Please check the dimensions of your original part before printing**, as vehicle interiors and parts may differ depending on the specific version of the car.

This is an independent 3D-printable replacement part and is not an official Volkswagen product.

If you print it, I would really appreciate a photo of your result and any feedback about the fit!
